title: Session Next-Trial Response
description: 200 response of POST /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/next-trial. Mirrors the backend handler (traigent_session_routes.get_next_trial -> _normalize_session_payload, which only canonicalizes session_status). A read response: additionalProperties:true so server-added fields validate. When the trial queue is exhausted, has_next is false and trial is null. Two producers share this schema: the classic handler (has_next, trial, remaining_trials, session_status) and the typed handler, which serves the same fields plus suggestion, should_continue, reason and stop_reason; the SDK reads should_continue and suggestion from the typed reply. Cross-field consistency is enforced: a terminal session_status never offers work (has_next false), has_next false carries trial null and no remaining work, and has_next true carries a concrete trial object (remaining_trials may be 0 for the final allocated trial).
x-content-note: INV-GAP (reclassified by review): open payload root accepts extra properties that carry no class; names and values are unclassified

has_next.description: Whether a next trial suggestion is available. false once the pre-generated trial queue is exhausted.

trial.x-content-note: INV-GAP S2: not inventoried (free object/array): trial
trial.description: The next trial suggestion, or null when has_next is false.

trial_id.x-content-note: INV-GAP: was opaque_ref; contract has no ref pattern, so the value is not provably content-free

config_refs.description: Content-less suggested configuration as knob_ref -> choice_ref|number (phase 2, additive), present instead of the name-keyed suggestion in agent_specification.

agent_specification.x-content-note: INV-GAP S2: not inventoried (free object/array): agent_specification
agent_specification.description: The agent configuration to evaluate for this trial.

dataset_subset_indices.x-content-note: INV-GAP S2: not inventoried (free object/array): dataset_subset_indices
dataset_subset_indices.description: Which dataset examples this trial is evaluated against. Null when the request sent no subset_size (the classic handler then evaluates the full dataset).

strategy.x-content-note: INV-GAP S2: not inventoried (free string): strategy

remaining_trials.description: Number of trials remaining in the session queue after this suggestion.

session_status.description: Canonical session lifecycle status (normalized server-side, lowercase). Terminal values never coexist with has_next true. Inlined, not $ref-ed, so this schema stays valid for a standalone validator; kept equal to session_lifecycle_status_schema.json by tests/test_session_lifecycle_status_contract.py.

suggestion.description: Typed-handler alias of trial: the same suggestion object, or null when no trial is offered. Absent on the classic handler.

should_continue.description: Typed-handler flag; always equal to has_next. The Python SDK reads it as required on the typed reply. Absent on the classic handler.

reason.description: Typed-handler stop reason (equal to stop_reason); null while the search continues. The SDK-sendable reasons of stop_reason_schema.json plus the Backend-originated budget_exhausted, max_wallclock_reached, smart_prune, search_complete and finalized.

stop_reason.description: Why the search stopped; null while it continues. Typed handler only. Same closed set as reason.

allOf.description: A terminal session_status never offers work: has_next is false.
has_next false: no trial, no queued work, and (typed handler) no suggestion and should_continue false.
has_next true: a concrete trial object (and, on the typed handler, the same object as suggestion). remaining_trials may be 0 (the final allocated trial) and is deliberately not constrained.
